Definition: Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some nothern nation
BiblicalUsage: Gog is the name of a Reubenite, a son of Shemaiah, and also the prophetic prince of Ezekiel's vision, Gog of the land of Magog. In 1 Chronicles 5:4, the text says "Gog his son."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gog matters because God names the enemies of His people as surely as He names His friends, and Gog is one of them.
